AGNES.acting: Agnes greets the unfamiliar man with composed caution, keeping him under steady observation.
AGNES.head: HEAD-NONE

WILL.acting: Will tries to appear courteous and at ease while remaining quietly drawn to her.
WILL.head: HEAD-NONE

beats.acting: The direct question makes Will visibly more self-conscious as he searches for a satisfactory answer.
Recognizing him as the Latin tutor, Agnes studies him with renewed interest.
Hearing that she has heard of him unsettles Will, and he briefly avoids her eyes.
Will falters under the pointed question, showing a sharper flicker of nervousness.
Agnes lightly chides his hesitation, allowing a trace of dry amusement into her composure.
Will searches for an explanation, looking upward as he gathers his thoughts.
The renewed hesitation exposes how uncertain he feels in her presence.
As he reaches the safer subject of the bird, Will lets his attention settle on it.
Agnes corrects him with quiet precision and turns her settled attention to the hawk.
